questions.question: Sexual harassment is best defined as:

answers.b: Unwelcome sexual advances, requests for sexual favors, and other verbal or physical conduct of a sexual nature

questions.question: Which type of sexual harassment involves employment decisions (like raises or promotions) being tied to submission to unwelcome sexual conduct?
Which example best fits “Hostile Work Environment”?

answers.a: A manager requires a date in exchange for a promotion
answers.b: Unwelcome sexual conduct creates an intimidating, hostile, or offensive workplace
answers.c: A co-worker asks for help with a task
answers.d: A supervisor gives a performance review

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of non-verbal harassment?
According to the training, what should you do if you experience or witness sexual harassment?

answers.a: Ignore it unless it happens again
answers.b: Confront the person publicly in front of others
answers.c: Document the incident and report it to HR or a supervisor following company procedures
answers.d: Post about it on social media first

questions.question: Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964 prohibits sexual harassment in the workplace.
Employers or managers may legally retaliate against someone for reporting harassment if the claim is inconvenient.
Which statement best reflects Illinois sexual harassment law?

answers.a: Only full-time employees are protected under Illinois sexual harassment law.
answers.b: A sexual harassment charge in Illinois must be filed with IDHR within 30 days.
answers.c:
Illinois law can protect nonemployees such as contractors, and a charge may generally be filed with IDHR
within 2 years.
answers.d: Illinois sexual harassment law applies only to employers with 15 or more employees.
